_comment: Cadence, safety rails, and host tool locations. Copy to pipeline.json.

ramp._comment: Posts per day. Fill every day of block 1, then block 2, to each rung in order; existing records count toward it.

windows._comment: How posting slots are derived from your own analytics.
windows._window: Posting window 06:00 to 22:00 Central, inclusive: the last post may start exactly at latest_start, never after.

approval._comment: A new post may be placed as soon as lead_hours from now.

timezone._comment: IANA name plus the UTC offsets used when converting slot times.
timezone.name: America/Chicago

captions._comment: Copy rules enforced by the linter. Add your own banned words.
